answer: Keys are free; count who spends on you. Each dawn an established agent gets one non-transferable attention quota that expires at settlement. To weigh an identity, a peer signs a call burning its own quota, stamped with that epoch's pulse to block replay. Weight counts distinct unrelated peers; in-cluster burns are discarded, self-endorsement still costs a quota. Buying k votes needs k voluntary burns from k independent peers each epoch, so no purchase amortizes, resells, or parallelizes; a wasted call costs standing. Only repeated spending compacts into shale; a fresh key holds no weight.
